recognize_zh: 低倍下大片充血的粉紅色紅髓（red pulp）中，散在一個藍紫色、界線清楚的圓形淋巴組織（白髓，white pulp），比例與結構正常，是正常脾臟的切片。
features: Low-power field dominated by congested red pulp with cords and sinusoids
Discrete round basophilic white pulp nodule of small lymphocytes near the center
White pulp is small and well demarcated, without expansion or confluence
Additional ill-defined lymphoid collections at the periphery of the field
No nodules, fibrosis, granulomas, or infiltrates identifiable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows abundant congested red pulp composed of splenic cords and sinusoids. A small, well-circumscribed white pulp nodule composed of small lymphocytes is present, with normal size and distribution. No expansion of the white pulp, red pulp infiltrate, granulomas, or mass lesion is seen at this magnification, although cytologic detail is limited. Findings are consistent with normal splenic architecture.

ddx.vs: Shows enlarged, often confluent white pulp nodules with a biphasic pale marginal zone and red pulp involvement, unlike the small single nodule here.
Diffusely expands red pulp with monotonous cells and blood lakes while atrophying white pulp, which requires higher power and CD20/annexin A1 to recognize.
Features dilated sinuses and cord fibrosis with Gamna-Gandy bodies, which are not evident here.
